text.p: Tropical Cyclone Justin will be a decreasing risk to shipping as it moves east-southeast and dissipates during the next 24-36 hours. It should be over water to the east of the Australian coast as it dissipates. Heavy rains along the coast of southern Queensland will continue for the next 12 hours, which may lead to some additional flooding. The hardest hit areas were to the north near Townsville, Cairns and Cooktown where heavy rain caused flooding during the weekend. Winds were also a problem when the system came onshore north of Cairns back on Friday and Saturday.
There are no further emergency statements at this time.
